thread:
Elena: Following the all-hands Q&A, opening a short live thread to capture concrete follow-ups about why we're seeing certain wins/losses and how feedback should flow back into roadmap decisions.
Marco: Quick signals from the session: customers love Dedicated latency promises, but we continue to lose some deals over unclear Private validation steps and pricing slabs.
Priya: Anecdote: a mid-market buyer dropped after 3 weeks due to "pricing slab surprises" during usage estimation. They asked for simple calculators and an upfront estimate flow.
Jun: Actionable: I'll prototype a minimal validation harness (curl smoke tests + KMS checklist) and a sample terraform snippet for VPC peering.
Sam: Data ask: can Rev/CS tag losses by primary reason (cost/ops/security/feature) so we can quantify top 3 causes monthly?
Priya: We can, but we need a short form. Suggest a 5-field lost-deal form CS fills in under 5 mins. Rev Ops volunteered previously to wire this.
Ava: Request from GTM: a 1-page "prospect-ready" FAQ that includes: expected perf (p50/p95), typical cost-saving knobs, and 2 rapid rebuttals for cost pushback.
Marco: I'll draft the FAQ and a one-paragraph case blurb of a customer that moved from Hosted -> Dedicated and cut per-token spend ~38%. ETA 10 business days.
Jun: I'll add the terraform + Nginx example to docs as a small snippet (owner: Docs) and a KMS smoke test script.
Sam: On roadmap priority: customers asked for both "console guided deploy" and "accelerated private scripts." Proposal: short-term = scripts/templates (1 sprint), parallel spike for console UX (Q2).
Elena: Agreed. Also want to close feedback loop: lost-deal signals should route into a weekly product triage board with a short action (triage/owner/ETA).
Ava: GTM can commit to 24-48h reviews if drafts are tagged.
Priya: Also please include a tiny decision checklist for customers: 1) latency target, 2) data residency/SLA needs, 3) cost ceiling. Helps reps recommend Dedicated vs Hosted vs Private.
ops-bot: Created task #5077 "AH follow-up: customer feedback & prospect FAQ" assigned to Marco, Jun. Due 2026-04-15.
Elena: Thanks. Recap of owners: Marco = prospect FAQ + case blurb (10bd), Jun = validation harness + snippets (5bd), Docs = publish quickstart, Rev Ops = lost-deal form -> product triage. We'll track progress in the product board and report back at the next all-hands.
